senses.gloss:
__1 A small red variety of garlic or onion (prohibited as food for द्विज); ल्शुनं गृञ्जनं चैव पलाण्डुं कवकानि च । अभक्ष्याणि द्विजातीनाममेध्यप्रभवाणि च ॥ [[Ms. 5. 5]]; [[Y. 1. 176.]] 
__2 A turnip. 
__3 The tops of hemp chewed to produce intoxication, the Gānjā. 
-नम् The meat of an animal destroyed by poisoned arrow; ‘अथ गृञ्जनं विषदिग्धपशोर्मांसे’ [[Med.]] | [[Mb. 13. 9. 39.]]
